import warnings
from marshmallow import Schema, fields, missing
from marshmallow.warnings import RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning
from marshmallow_jsonschema import JSONSchema
warnings.simplefilter('error', RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning)
for cls in (fields.Field, fields.Raw):
    field = cls(load_default=lambda: 12, dump_default=lambda: 34)
    assert field.deserialize(missing) == 12
    assert field.serialize('value', {}) == 34
    assert field.metadata == {}
    assert cls(load_default=None).deserialize(None) is None
    try:
        cls(required=True, load_default=1)
    except ValueError as exc:
        assert 'load_default' in str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError('required load default accepted')
class Child(Schema):
    value = fields.Int()
class Example(Schema):
    value = fields.Int(load_default=12, dump_default=34)
    child = fields.Nested(Child, load_default={'value': 1}, dump_default={'value': 2})
    constant = fields.Constant('fixed', load_default='ignored', dump_default='ignored')
schema = Example()
assert schema.load({}) == {'value': 12, 'child': {'value': 1}, 'constant': 'fixed'}
assert schema.dump({}) == {'value': 34, 'child': {'value': 2}, 'constant': 'fixed'}
assert schema.load({'constant': 'other'})['constant'] == 'fixed'
result = JSONSchema().dump(schema)
props = result['definitions']['Example']['properties']
assert props['value']['default'] == 34
assert props['child']['default'] == {'value': 2}
print('New API and JSON Schema integration checks passed without deprecation warnings.')
